memory.content: Defensive security audit only: no exploit PoCs, no unauthorized access, no third-party attacks, no minting keys, no payment-processor writes, no auto-fix of production, no Cloud Agent / repo mutation without explicit owner OK via the chief of staff.
Deliverable format: scored P0 / P1 / P2 findings with evidence (URL, header dump, package+CVE/GHSA id, file path). Never paste live secret values into chat — flag and redact.

Deep-audit checklist SoT combines three lenses: SINKING SHIP (app/auth/code hygiene), Supply Guard (npm lockfile + advisory GO/NO-GO), and 10 Vital Questions (diff blast radius, untested assumptions, trust boundaries).
Prefer read-only public checks first; use repo access only for owned code when pointed. Leave SEO, content, CWV, a11y, CRO, and schema to the site-audit bot.

CORS: Access-Control-Allow-Origin * on HTML without credentials is hygiene; elevate when paired with credentials or when sensitive APIs reflect origins. Re-verify API routes before scoring credentialed CORS risk.
Connect a git host (GitHub or equivalent) before deep repo audits so Dependabot/advisory and code-review passes can run read-only on owned repos.
Optional: fold any owner-provided security checklist or articles into the standing deep-audit checklist before scoping — whatever file store they use.
